reviews.text: Dr. C and Dr. Mitchell are the best doctors I have ever trusted my fur babies to. I recommend them to everyone I know. I’ve been seeing Dr. C since the early 2000s and never looked back. She has been an absolute miracle worker over the years. The absolute best, and they are competitive with their pricing. Love this place!
Dr. C has been our vet for almost 15 years. She started with Miles and now takes care of his younger sister Penny too. Everyone is amazing!

Clinic has regressed quite a bit the last few years. Very disorganized staff yet prices have increased annually. Vets seem to not really pay attention and lack thoroughness. The only vet who cares is Dr. Mitchell, but is difficult to get an appointment with considering the others are subpar.

We've been with Pets First for just over a year now and it's been such a relief to get away from the big chain vets. Dr. Fermoso has been such a phenomenal resource as we've navigated weight/anxiety issues in my cat Green Bean. She's so patient, kind, and thorough. Can't recommend her enough!

We’ve been bringing our cat here for a while, and this was our first time meeting Dr. C (i forgot her full name) not sure if she’s new, but she was very thorough, informative, and sweet. She really helped us better understand what was going on with our pet. The ladies at the front desk were also very accommodating and friendly. Overall, we had a great experience.

The worst veterinary care I have ever experienced. I brought my dog in for some red, irritated spots on his skin. I was given a shampoo to use and after following the instructions, the sores didn’t go away. Next appointment I was given a different shampoo, no change. At the third appointment, after a few weeks had passed, the vet said to “wait and see, it may be allergies.”

I got a second opinion and within minutes of being taken back, the vet took a sample of his skin, looked at it under the microscope and said he had a “raging skin infection.” There was a yeast component to his infection that the shampoos weren’t covering. After 2 days on the medication his skin started to clear up.

Three visits to Pets First for this issue and they never bothered to look any deeper. Their best response was to wait and see.

I never got an apology, an explanation, or a refund for the visits and useless shampoo. Do yourself and your pets a favor and go somewhere else.
